ud2.3:1.1: evam me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikass' ārāme. tena kho pana samayena sambahulā kumārakā antarā ca Sāvatthiṃ antarā ca Jetavanaṃ ahiṃ daṇḍena hananti. atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. addasā kho bhagavā sambahule kumārake antarā ca Savatthiṃ antarā ca Jetavanaṃ ahiṃ daṇḍena hanante.
ud2.3:2.1: atha kho bhagavā etaṃ atthaṃ viditvā tayaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud2.3:3.1: {sukhakāmāni bhūtāni} yo daṇḍena vihiṃsati attano sukham esāno, pecca so na labhate sukhaṃ.
ud2.3:4.1: sukhakāmāni bhūtāni yo daṇḍena na hiṃsati attano sukham esāno, pecca so labhate sukhan ti. ||3||
